This time [Gemini](https://gemini.google.com) writes the SQL. Copy each block
(use the copy button in its top right corner) and paste it into Gemini. Run
the blocks in order in the same chat: the table schemas tell Gemini what your
tables look like, so they have to go first.

Then copy the query Gemini writes into the DoltHub SQL editor for your
coffee shop database and run it. Look at the result and check that it really answers the question.

## Set Up Database First (without AI)

Use this SQL script to set up a new database:
[create-coffee-shop-db.sql](../lectures/sql/create-coffee-shop-db.sql)

## Table Schemas to Give to AI

Paste this first to Gemini as you ask it to write queries for you. It shows the two tables, their columns, and how they
connect.

```sql
-- in_stock is 1 if the item is available and 0 if it isn't.
CREATE TABLE products (
  product_id int NOT NULL,
  name varchar(255),
  category varchar(255),
  price decimal(10,2),
  in_stock tinyint,
  PRIMARY KEY (product_id)
);

-- completed is 1 if the order has been completed and 0 if it is still waiting.
CREATE TABLE orders (
  order_id int NOT NULL,
  product_id int NOT NULL,
  customer_name varchar(255),
  quantity int,
  order_date date,
  completed tinyint,
  PRIMARY KEY (order_id),
  FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products (product_id)
);
```

## Question 1

```default
Show the name and price of every Tea product, sorted from most expensive to least expensive.
```

## Question 2

```default
For every order that is still waiting, show the customer_name, the product's name, and the quantity.
```

## Question 3

```default
Show the order_id, customer_name, and order_total, the quantity times the product's price, of the 3 orders with the highest order_total.
```

## Question 4

```default
For each category, show the category and units_sold, the total quantity ordered of products in that category, sorted from most units sold to fewest.
```

## Question 5

```default
Show the name of every product that has never been ordered.
```

## Question 6

```default
Can you give me 5 more examples of natural language prompts and the corresponding SQL queries you would write for this database?
```
